a: अनुवाचनं — 1 Recitation of passages of the Ṛgveda by the Hotṛ priest in obedience to the injunction (प्रैष) of the अध्वर्यु priest. --2 Causing to recite, teaching, instructing. --3 Reading to oneself; see above.

m: अनु-वाचन—प्रैष m. an injunction to recite as above, KātyŚr.

v: anuvAda

pu॰ anu + vada--GaY । viDiprAptasya vAkyAntareRa kaTane yaTA agnihotraM juhotIti vAkyena prAptasya homasyu daDnA juhotIti vAkyena punaranuvAdena daDikaraRakatvamAtraM tatra viDeyam । tatra homasyAnuvAdaH evamanyatrApyUhyam anuvAdaH pUrvvasyeti kA॰ 4, 3, 18, “ya izwyetyanena vAkyena pOrRamAsyAmamAvasyAyAM vA vikftInAmanuzWAnamucyate tacca prakftitaH prAptameva ataH kAraRAt ya izwyetyanuvAda iti tadvyA॰ । anuvAdaSca triviDa BUtArTAnuvAdaH stutyarTAnuvAdaH guRAnuvAdaSceti । tatra sadeva sOmyedamagra AsIdityAdO BUtArTAnuvAdaH । “vAyurvEkzipizWA devatetyAdO, stutyarTAnuvAdaH । vAyavyaM SvetaM CAganAlaBatetyAdO, prAptAyA vAyudevatAyAH stutyaryatvAt tasya stunyaryAnuvAdatvam । agnihotraM juhotIti prAptasyAgnihotrahomasya guRaviDAnArTaM pravfttaM daDnA juhotItyAdi guRAnuvAdaH । evasanyAnyapyudAhAryyARi । anukzaRakaTane । “ka uttamaH SlokaguRAnuvAdAt pumAn virajyeta vinA puSuGnAditi” BAga॰ “sidDopadeSe ca “anuvAde caraRAnAmiti” pA॰ । “sidDopadeSe” iti si॰ kO॰ ।
m: अनु-वाद m. saying after or again, repeating by way of explanation, explanatory repetition or reiteration with corroboration or illustration, explanatory reference to anything already said
translation
a passage of the Brāhmaṇas which explains or illustrates a rule (विधि) previously propounded (such a passage is sometimes called अनुवाद-वचन)
confirmation, Nir.
slander, reviling, L.
(used in explaining ध्वनि), Kpr.
a: अनुवादः — 1 Repetition (in general); गुण˚ K. 206. --2 Repetition by way of explanation, illustration or corroboration; अनुवादे चरणानां P. II. 4. 3 (सिद्धस्योपन्यासे Sk.). --3 Explanatory repetition or reference to what is already mentioned, such as paraphrase or free translation; particularly, any portion of the Brāhmaṇas which comments on, illustrates, or explains a Vidhi or direction previously laid down and which does not itself lay down any directions; a supplementary repetition, opp. to विधि ‘authoritative or direct injunction’; विधिविहितस्य अनुवचनमनुवादः . नानुवादपुनरुक्तयोः विशेषः शब्दाभ्यासोपपत्तेः Nyāya Sūtra. It is of 3 kinds:--भूतार्थ˚ (सदेव सौम्येदमग्र आसीत्); स्तुत्यर्थ˚ (वायुर्वै क्षेपिष्ठा देवता) and गुण˚ (अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति इत्युक्ते दध्ना जुहोति इति गुणविधानांत्); see अर्थवाद also. --4 Corroboration, confirmation. --5 Slander, abuse, reviling. --6 Advertisement, notice; report, rumour. --7 Commencement of speech ( वाचारंभणमात्रं.).

v: anuvAdaka

m: अनु-वादक or अनु-वादिन्, mfn. repeating with comment and explanation, corroborative, concurrent, conformable, in harmony with (the masculine of the last is also the name of any one of the three notes of the gamut.)
a: अनुवादक, --वादिन् — a. 1 Explanatory, corroborative, repeating with comment, explanation or illustration; आरंभश्च साहसानुवादी Dk. 95 bespeaks. --2 Conformable to, in harmony with, like; युक्तगीतानुवादिना Rām.; तदनुवादिगुणः कुसुमोद्गमः R. 9. 30. --न् m. N. of any one of the three notes of the gamut.

m: अनु-वाद्य mfn. to be explained by an anuvāda, to be made the subject of one
अनु-वाद्य n. the subject of a predicate.
a: अनुवाद्य — pot. p. 1 To be explained or illustrated. --2 (In gram.) To be made the subject of an assertion (in a sentence), opposed to विधेय which affirms or denies something about the subject. In a sentence the अनुवाद्य or subject which is supposed to be already known is repeated to mark its connection with the विधेय or predicate and should be placed first; अनुवाद्यमनुक्त्वैव न विधेयमुदीरयेत्; in वृद्धिरादैच् आदैच् should have been placed first, though the construction is defended by Patañjali.

m: अनु-वाद्य—त्व n. the state of requiring to be explained by an anuvāda.
अनुवाकानुक्रमणी f. a work referring to the Ṛg-veda, attributed to Śaunaka.

II. 4. 29 Vārt.] 1 Repeating, reciting, reading. --2 A subdivision of the Vedas, section, chapter. --3 Chapter or section referring to a compilation from the Ṛgveda or Yajurveda (ऋग्यजुःसमूह). --Comp. --अनुक्रमणी N. of a table of contents attributed to Śaunaka.

administering oily enemata.

(अनुवसति अनुवासरं वा दीयते अनुवसन्नपि न दुष्यति अनुदिवसं वा दीयते इति अनुवासनः).

m: अनु-√ वच् to recite the formulas inviting to the sacrificial ceremony; to repeat, reiterate, recite; to communicate; to study: Caus. -वचयति, to cause to recite the inviting formulas, to cause to invite for some sacrificial act, KātyŚr.
a: अनुवच् — {c2c} P. 1 To say or speak after or for one; येषां द्विजानां सावित्री नानूच्येत यथाविधि Ms. 11. 191. --2 To repeat, recite, reiterate; शतमनूच्यमायुष्कामस्य Ait. Br.; learn, study; परोवरं यज्ञोऽनूच्यते Śat. Br.; अरण्येऽनूच्यमानत्वादारण्यकं Sāy., see अनूचान below. --3 To concede the point, assent to, yield. --4 To name, call. --Caus. To cause to recite; to read to oneself (before reading aloud); oft. used in dramas; उभे नाम मुद्राक्षराण्यनुवाच्य परस्परमवलोकयतः Ś. 1; निपु-(गृहीत्वा) कथं वाच्यतां; देवी-अनुवाचय तावत् यद्यविरुद्धं श्रोष्यामि V. 2; Mu. 1; अनुवाचितलेखममात्यमवलोक्य M. 1.

lecture
a chapter, a section
recitation of certain texts in conformity with injunctions (प्रैष) spoken by other priests.

m: अनु-√ वद् P. (with acc.) to repeat the words of; to imitate (in speaking); to resound; to repeat, insist upon; (according to Pāṇ. i, 3, 49, also Ā. if without object or followed by a Gen.) Pass. (अनूद्यते) to be expressed correspondingly; cf. अनूदित s.v.
a: अनुवद् — {c1c} P. 1 To imitate in speaking, mock (with acc.); गिरं नः… अनुवदति शुकस्ते मंजुवाक् पंजरस्थः R. 5. 74 repeat; उक्तमनुवदति Sk.; (P. & Ā.) to resound, echo; अनुवदति वीणा P. I. 3. 49 Sk. अनुवदते कठः कलापस्य ibid.; सभाभित्तिप्रतिध्वानैर्भयादन्ववदन्निव Śi. 2. 67 echoed and approved also; घोषस्यान्ववदिष्टेव लंका पूतक्रतोः पुरः Bk. 8. 29. --2 To repeat or say again by way of explanation, illustration or corroboration; See Kull. on Ms. 1. 74; 2. 6. --3 To repeat, tell, say (generally); निजमनोरथमनुवदंत्या Dk. 21. --4 To abuse, rail at. --Caus. To cause to resound or echo.

m: अनु-√ वृत् Ā. to go after; to follow, pursue; to follow from a previous rule, be supplied from a previous sentence; to attend; to obey, respect, imitate; to resemble; to assent; to expect; Caus. P. -वर्तयति, to roll after or forward; to follow up, carry out; to supply.
अनु-वृत् mfn. walking after, following, MaitrS.; PBr.
a: अनुवृत् — {c1c} A. (sometimes P. also) 1 (Transitively used) (a) To go or roll after, follow, pursue; (fig.) to follow, conform to, act according to, obey, adapt oneself to, be guided by; humour; अहं तावत्स्वामिनश्चित्तवृत्तिमनुवर्तिष्ये Ś. 2; तेऽपि परिचयमनुवर्तंते K. 289; किमत्र चित्रं यदि विशाखे शशांकलेखामनुवर्तेते Ś. 3 approve of her choice; लौकिकानां हि साधूनामर्थं वागनुवर्तते U. 1. 10 words conform to the sense; न कुलक्रममनुवर्तते K. 104 follow; मधु द्विरेफः कुसुमैकपात्रे पपौ प्रियां स्वामनुवर्तमानः Ku. 3. 36 followed his mate in drinking, drank after her; Bh. 2. 110; Bg. 3. 23; Dk. 80, 96, 126; कृतज्ञतामनुवर्तमानेन Mu. 3 following the path of gratitude; प्रभुचित्तमेव हि जनोऽनुवर्तते Śi. 15. 41; Māl. 3. 2. (b) To imitate, resemble; equal; तेऽन्ववर्तन् पितॄन्सर्वे यशसा च बलेन च Mb. (c) To gratify, humour, please; Dk. 65. --2 (Intransitively used) (a) To follow, come after; संग्राह्य इत्यनुवर्तते H. 3. (b) To continue, endure. (c) To act towards, behave. (d) (In gram.) To be repeated or supplied from a preceding rule, Sūtra or assertion (said of a word or rule which continues to exercise influence on what follows); e. g. in P. IV. 3. 95 भक्तिः सोऽस्य (occurring in Sūtra 89 before) इत्यनुवर्तते Sk. --Caus. 1 To cause to revolve, turn round; एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः Bg. 3. 16. --2 To act up to, follow, obey; तथापि लोकयात्रानुवर्तनीया Mv. 7; पुत्रैः पितरो लोकद्वयेप्यनुवर्तनीयाः Ve. 3; K. 367. --3 To favour, oblige; comply with one's request; विधिनापि भवतेव वयमनुवर्तिताः K. 73; यथाचित्तमनुवर्तनीयः Māl. 7. --4 To put in, carry out. --5 To repeat or supply from a preceding Sūtra; केचित्तु विजायते इति नानुवर्तयंति P. V. 2. 13 Sk. --6 To use, employ. --7 To lead one to, attach to. --8 To speak in favour of, speak for; to approve. --9 To imitate, do after one; सतां चरितान्यनुवर्तितानि नद्रियाणि K. 298.

reverting to
imitating, doing or acting in like manner.
(in dram.) politeness, courtesy, Sāh.
a: अनुवृत्तिः — f. 1 Assenting to, approval; तवानुवृत्तिं न च कर्तुमुत्सहे Ku. 5. 65. --2 Obedience, conformity, following, continuance in (opp. व्यावृत्ति); taking up; continuity; ज्येष्ठानुवृत्तिजटिलं R. 13. 78 by following the example of; अनुवृत्त्या प्रमार्ष्टुमागतः Dk. 100 service; ततान वह्निः पवनानुवृत्त्या Ki. 16. 52 in consequence of. --3 Acting according or suitably to, compliance, acquiescence; gratifying, pleasing; कांता˚चातुर्यमपि शिक्षितं वत्सेन U. 3; Māl. 9; Śi. 9. 58; Dk. 55; K. 265; M. 2. 9; राज्यं हि नाम राजधर्म˚ परस्य नृपतेर्महदप्रीतिस्थानं Mu. 3 who conforms to or is true to the duties of kings; (previous) compliant or obedient spirit, previous course of conduct; U. 7. 5. --4 Remembrance Ki. 18. 18. --5 (Gram.) Being supplied or repeated in a following rule; continued influence of a preceding on a following rule. --6 Imitating, resembling &c. --7 Repetition; वर्णानामनुवृत्तिरनुप्रासः.

a: अनुविद्ध — See under अनुव्यध्.

अनुविद्ध — p. p. 1 Pierced, bored; कीटानुविद्धरत्नादिसाधारण्येन काव्यता S. D. --2 Overspread, intertwined; surrounded, full of; pervaded by, replete or filled with, abounding in, mixed or blended with, intermixed; सरसिजमनुविद्धं शैवलेनापि रम्यं Ś. 1. 20; क्वचित्प्रभालेपिभिरिंद्रनीलैर्मुक्तामयी यष्टिरिवानुविद्धा R. 13. 54 interwoven with emeralds; 16. 48, 6. 18; अलके बालकुंदानुविद्धं Me. 65; सौरभ्य˚ Mk. 1; कोपानुविद्धां चिंतां नाटयन् Mu. 3; Ku. 3. 35; पांडुतानुविद्धेव देहच्छविः Dk. 112; 137; Māl. 1. --3 Connected with, relating to; adhering to; देशवार्तानुविद्धा संकथा Dk. 117, 124; उद्रूर्णलोष्टलगुडैः परितोऽनुविद्धं Śi. 5. 25 chased, closely followed or pursued. --4 Set, inlaid; variegated; रत्नानुविद्धार्णवमेखलाया दिशः सपत्नी भव दक्षिणस्याः R. 6. 63, 14; Śi. 4. 49.

m: अनु-विद्वस् mfn. perf. p. having found, AV.
अनु-वि-√ हन् to interrupt, derange, MBh.
अनु-वि-√ काश् Intens. -चाकशीति, to penetrate with one's vision, AV.
अनु-वि-√ 1. कॄ to bestrew, ŚBr.; to scatter separately, ĀpŚr.
अनु-वि-√ कस् to blow, expand, as a flower.
अनु-वि-√ 1. कृ to shape after, ŚBr.
अनु-वि-√ क्रम् Ā. to step or walk after, follow, AV. &c.
अनु-वि-√ ली to dissolve (as salt in water), ŚBr. xiv.
अनु-वि-√ लोक् (P. -लोकयति), to survey, Divyāv.
अनु-वि-√ मृश् to consider, Daś.
अनु-वि-नाश m. perishing after.
a: अनुविनाशः — Perishing after.

v: anuvinDya
pu॰ avantideSIye nfpatiBede “vinDyAnuvinDyAvAvantyAviti” BA॰ BI॰ pa॰ ।

m: अनु-वि-√ 2. नश् to disappear, perish, vanish after or with another (acc.), AV. &c.
a: अनुविनश् — {c4c} P. To disappear, vanish or perish after or along with another.

m: अनु-वि-√ नद् Caus. P. -नादयति, to make resonant or musical.
अनु-वि-√ नर्द् to answer with roars, Hariv.
अनु-विन्द m. N. of a king of Oujein.
अनु-वि-निः-√ सृ to go or come out in order, MārkP.
अनु-वि-√ पश् -वि-पश्यति, to look at, view, ŚBr.; PBr.
अनु-वि-√ राज् to be bright after or along, RV. v, 81, 2.
अनु-वि-√ सृ to extend or stream over, TBr.
अनु-वि-√ सृज् to shoot at or towards; to send along (acc.), RV. v, 53, 6.
अनु-विस्मित mfn. one who is astonished after another, R.
अनु-वि-√ स्रंस् Caus. -स्रंसयति, to separate, loose, ŚBr.
अनु-विस्तृत mfn. (√ स्तृ), ‘extended, spread out’, large, roomy, R.
अनु-वि-√ तन् to extend all along or all over, ŚBr.
अनु-वित्त mfn. found, obtained, at hand, ŚBr. xiv, &c.
अनु-वित्ति f. finding, ŚBr.
a: अनुवित्तिः — f. Finding, obtaining.

m: अनु-वि-√ वा to blow while passing through, TBr.
अनु-वि-√ वृत् to run along, RV. viii, 103, 2 : Caus. Ā. -वर्तयते, to follow hastily, AV.
अनु-वि-√ विश् to settle along separately, TS.
अनु-विष्णु ind. after Viṣṇu.
after Viṣṇu, Laghuk. 972.
अनु-वि-ष्ठा (√ स्था) to extend over, RV. &c.
अनु-वि-षण्ण mfn. (√ सद्), fixed upon, ChUp.
अनु-वि-षिच् (√ सिच्) to pour in addition to (acc.), AV.

a: अनुविष्टंभः — Being obstructed in consequence of.

m: अनु-विष्टम्भ m. the being impeded in consequence of Nir.
अनु-वि-ष्यन्द् (√ स्यन्द्) to flow over or along or upon, ŚBr.

a: अनुव्राज्य — pot. p. To be followed as by the relatives of a dead person to the cemetery.

m: अनु-√ व्रज् to go along, ĀśvŚr.; to follow (especially a departing guest, as a mark of respect); to visit seriatim; to obey, do homage.
a: अनुव्रज् — {c1c} P. 1 To follow, go after; तां व्रजंतीमनुवव्राज K. 132, 210; attend especially a departing guest (as far as the bank of water, lake, &c.) as a mark of respect; Y. 1. 113; तं मातरो देवमनुव्रजंत्यः Ku. 7. 38; यमिच्छेत्पुनरायांतं नैनं दूरमनुव्रजेत् Rām. --2 To visit in order, seek. --3 To go to or near; betake oneself to; मृगा मृगैः संगमनुव्रजंति Pt. 1 deer herd or associate with deer. --4 To obey, to do homage to.

s: klI, (anu + vraja + BAve lyuw .) anuvrajyA । gfhAgatAnAM SizwAnAM gamanasamaye kiyaddUraparyyantapaScAdgamanarUpaSizwAcAraH । Aga vAqAna iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “AyAntamagrato gacCet gacCantaM tamanuvrajet” । iti tantrasAre nigamakalpadrumaH ॥
v: anuvrajana

na॰ anu + vraja + BAve lyuw । anugamane anuvrajanaM ca gacCato'tisnigDAdeH jalasamIpaparyyantAnuDAvanam taTEvopamAviDayA varRRitaM nEzaDe “vanAntaparyyantamupetya saspfhaM krameRa tasminnaTa tIrRRadfkpaTe । nyavarttidfzwiprakarEH purOkasAmanuvrajadbanDusamAjabanDuBiriti” ।
m: अनु-व्रजन n. following as above, Hcat.
a: अनुव्रजनं, --व्रज्या — Following, going after, especially a departing guest; Ms. 3. 107.

v: anuvrajyA
strI anu + vraja--kyap । anusaraRAdirUpe sevane । “abrAhmaRAdaDyayanamApatkAle viDIyate । anuvrajyA ca SuSrUzA yAvadaDyayanaM guroriti” manuH ।
m: अनु-व्रज्या f. = अनु-व्रजन, Mn. &c.
अनु-व्रज्य mfn. to be followed (as by the relatives of a dead person to the cemetery), Yājñ. iii, 1

v: anuvrata
tri॰ anukUlaM vrataM karmma yasya । anukUlakarmmayukte । “anuvratAya ranDayannapavratAyeti f॰ 1, 5, 9, anuvratAya anukUlakarmyaRe iti BA॰ । vESyAH kzatramanuvratAH rAmA॰
m: अनु-व्रत mfn. devoted to, faithful to, ardently attached to (with gen. or acc.)
a: अनुव्रत — a. [अनुकूलं व्रतं कर्म यस्य] 1 Devoted or faithful to, attached to (with acc. or gen.); प्रियतमा का अनुव्रता Bh. 2. 103; वैश्याः क्षत्रमनुव्रताः Rām. --2 Duly performing the vows or duties prescribed (opp. अपव्रत). --तः A class of Jaina ascetics.

m: अनु-व्य्-आ-√ ख्या to explain further, ṢaḍvBr.; ChUp.

v: anuvyAKyAna
ta॰ anurUpaM vyAKyAnam prA॰ sa॰ । mantrAdInAmanurUpArTaprakASake vyAKyAne ।
m: अनु-व्याख्यान n. that portion of a Brāhmaṇa which explains or illustrates difficult Sūtras, texts or obscure statements occurring in another portion, ŚBr. xiv.
a: अनुव्याख्यानं — [अनुरूपं व्याख्यानं] That which comments on and explains Mantras, Sūtras &c. ( मंत्रविवरणं); especially, that portion of a Brāhmaṇa which explains difficult Sūtras, texts &c. occurring in another place ( मंत्रादीनामनुरूपार्थप्रकाशकं व्याख्यानं.)

v: anuvyAhAra
pu॰ anu + vi + A + hf--GaY । anuvAde, sahakaTane ca ।
m: अनु-व्याहार m. cursing, execration, KātyŚr.
अनु-व्याहारिन् mfn. execrating, cursing, ŚBr.
a: अनुव्याहारिन् — a. Cursing; execrating.

m: अनु-व्याहरण n. repeated utterance, R.
a: अनुव्याहरणं, --व्याहारः — 1 Repetition, repeated utterance; mentioning along with something else. --2 A curse, imprecation.

m: अनु-व्य्-आ-√ हृ to utter in order or repeatedly, MaitrUp.; to curse, ŚBr. &c.
अनु-व्याहृत n. curse, imprecation, MBh.
अनु-व्यापिन् mfn. (ifc.) spreading over, covering, filling, Jātakam.
अनु-व्य्-आ-√ स्था Caus. -स्थापयति, to send away in different directions, TBr.
अनु-व्य्-√ 1. ऊह् to move apart after, PBr.; to distribute, ŚBr.

v: anuvya
tri॰ anuvyayati anugacCati anu + vye--ka । anugate tato devA anuvyamivAsuH kA॰ 1, 2, 5, anuvyam anugamanaM nyagBUtiM “prAptA iva baBUvuriti tadvyA॰ ।
a: अनुव्य — a. [अनुव्ययति अनुगच्छति व्येक] Following (अनुगत); ˚व्यमिवासुः Kāty. (न्यग्भूमिं प्राप्ता इव).

m: अनु-√ व्यध् cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, to strike afterwards, Mn.; to penetrate, pierce through, wound.
a: अनुव्यध् — {c4c} P. 1 To hit or pierce again; विद्धमनुविध्यतः Ms. 9. 43. --2 To wound, pierce; कामशरानुविद्धः &c. --3 To fill or mix with, blend with, see अनुविद्ध below. --4 To impel, urge.
अनुव्यंजनं — A secondary token.

m: अनु-व्य्-√ 1. अश् to overtake, reach, ŚBr.
अनु-व्यञ्जन n. a secondary mark or token, Buddh.
अनु-व्यम् ind. (√ वी), behind, after, inferior to, ŚBr.; PBr.
अनु-व्य्-अव-√ 1. गा cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, to come between in succession to another, ŚBr.

a: अनुव्यवसायः — (In Nyāya) Consciousness of the perception; (in Vedānta phil.) perception of a sentiment or judgment.

m: अनु-व्य्-अव-√ सो to perceive.
अनु-व्य्-अवे (√ इ) cl. 2. P. -अवैति, to follow in intervening or coming between, ŚBr.
अनु-व्य्-उच्-√ चर् to follow in going forth, ŚBr.
